Well, well! If it isn't our favorite warmonger-slash-patron of public spectacle. We're prepping the next fleet melee...

texts.zh: 啊，你是在找个新人吗？战士、掮客、旅者……他们可不是那种你看一眼就会过忘的货色，这星系也难得让他们销声匿迹太久。我们在旅途中确实遇到过几位。但朋友，在这片地界，天下没有免费的午餐。付了我们的猎头费，我就为你安排见面。
texts.en: Ah, looking for someone new for your roster? Warriors, fixers, wayfarers... Not the sort you forget, and the galaxy rarely lets them drift far for long. We have encountered a few in our travels. But nothing's free out here, friend. Pay our scouting fee, and I'll arrange an introduction.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh:
那人以军人的姿态登舰，面容因悲痛和多年的流亡而变得坚毅。他的声音低沉、从容，带着钢铁般的锋利。

“我的世界被清洗了，我的族人，我的家人……唯我幸存。我隐忍至今。而那些毁灭的始作俑者，必将死于我手。”
texts.en:
The figure steps aboard with a soldier's bearing, their features hardened by grief and long years of exile. Their voice is low, measured, and edged with iron.

"My world was cleansed, my people, my family... I alone survived. I endure. And the architects of annihilation will die by my hand."

responses.zh:
此人停顿下来，仿佛说出自己的名字会撕裂旧伤。

“一个名字尚存，尽管其意义已成灰烬。我曾是一名士兵，忠诚而顺从。如今，我是一个被毁灭民族的影子。

如果你非要称呼我，就叫我奥伦·维斯吧。我的过去已不再重要。重要的只有那未偿还的血债。”
responses.en:
They pause, as if speaking their own name tears at an old wound.

"A name remains, but its meaning is ash. I was a soldier once, dutiful and obedient. Now I am the shadow of a people destroyed.

"Call me Orun Veyth, if you must. My past no longer matters. Only the debt of blood unpaid."

responses.zh:
“你的方舟舰不带任何暴政的旗帜。这便是我站在你面前的原因。我很久以前就明白，一颗星球便是一座牢笼。一旦屠杀开始，便无处可逃。但你们在移动，因此你们能经受磨难。”

“追随你们，此类惨剧或可被蔑视，而我的利刃也将转向那些行下屠行的屠夫。”
responses.en:
"Your Arkship carries no flag of tyranny. That is why I stand before you. I learned long ago that a planet is a cage. Once the slaughter begins, there is no escape. But you move, and so you endure.

"With you, such horrors may be defied, and my blade turned against the butchers who commit them."

responses.zh:
“复仇。”

这两个字在空气中凝滞。陌生人探身向前，每一根筋腱都因强压下的怒火而绷得紧紧的。

“向那些进行清洗的人复仇，向那些屠杀无辜者却将其称之为‘政策’的人复仇。

为了看到这些怪物覆灭，我不惜跨越万水千山，忍受任何伤痛。

助我一臂之力，我将以效忠于你来践行我的誓言。”
responses.en:
"Vengeance."

The word hangs in the air. The stranger leans forward, every sinew drawn tight with barely contained rage.

"Vengeance on those who purge, on those who slaughter the innocent and call it 'policy.'

"To see such monsters undone, I will cross any distance, endure any wound.

"Aid me, and I will seal my oath in your service."

label.zh: 你能否在追求个人目标的同时，也为我们的事业效力？
label.en: Can you serve our cause while pursuing your own?

responses.zh:
“复仇是我的志向，但不必成为你的负担。只要那些星球屠夫尚存一息，我便会追猎不止。在为你效劳的过程中，我将磨砺我的利刃。”

他们的目光变得锐利，掠食者般的锋芒穿透了自律的面具。

“请以我带来的力量来评价我，而非我留下的伤痕。”
responses.en:
"Vengeance is my purpose, but it need not be your burden. So long as planetary butchers draw breath, I will hunt them. In your service I shall sharpen my blade."

Their gaze sharpens, a predatory gleam breaking through the mask of discipline.

"Judge me by the strength I bring, not the scars I bear."

responses.zh:
紧接着发出的那声咕哝，是他们最接近笑声的反应。

“如果是呢？熟络就能换来同情吗？身体不过是工具。而我的身体，将收割复仇。”
responses.en:
The grunt that follows is as close as they come to laughter.

"And if I was? Does familiarity buy me sympathy? A body is a tool. Mine will reap vengeance."

label.en: Orun Veyth first destroys a fleet of an empire that purged pops

texts.zh:
敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。

奥伦·维斯注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。

“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”
texts.en:
The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.

Watching on the view screen, Orun Veyth does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the silence that follows, their promise endures.

"Each such foe cast down steels our resolve. We will continue to strike against those who practice annihilation, and we will not relent.

tooltips.zh: 复仇誓言特质的效果提高+5%。
tooltips.en: Effects of the Oath of the Revenant trait increase by +5%.

texts.zh:
你面前站着一位穿着仪式礼袍的流浪者，饰品与织物的排列显然经过精心打理。反重力伺服器嗡嗡地震动着，驱动着一本法典漂浮在她面前。当她终于开口时，每个字听起来都不像是回答，而更像是一个未问出口的问题的回响。

“意外与命运生着别无二致的面孔，而今天它转向了你。”
texts.en:
Before you stands a wanderer robed in ceremonial layers, ornaments and fabrics arranged with deliberate care. Antigravity servos within the codex that floats before her cause it to hum and gently vibrate. When she finally speaks, each word feels less like an answer than the echo of an unasked question.

"Accident and destiny share one face, and today it turns toward you."

responses.zh: “名字如容器；我的名字恰巧是亚夏尔。但唯有虚空的容器，方能成就其用。”
responses.en: "A name is a vessel; mine happens to be Ashar. But only the empty vessel can serve its purpose."

responses.zh:
“那些陈旧梦想毫无意义。唯有在运动中，指引方能流淌；唯有在变革中，智慧方能呼吸。”

异星人的存在感如同件无重量的斗篷般降临，连空气似乎都在其陪伴下凝固了。

“告诉我：人若不是在寻找那缺失之物，又是在寻找什么呢？”
responses.en:
"The settled dream without meaning. Only in motion can counsel flow, and only in change can wisdom breathe."

The alien's presence settles like a weightless mantle, the air itself seeming to fall still in her company.

"Tell me instead: what does anyone seek, if not what is absent?"

responses.zh:
外星人沉默了许久，仿佛满足于让这份寂静作为回答。也许她并非在权衡你的话语，而是在掂量发问者的分量。

“为了入座你的阴影，为打破沉寂时的话语，为了提醒你连星辰也在流浪。”
responses.en:
The alien pauses for a long time, as though content to let her silence answer. Perhaps she is not weighing your words, but the worth of the one who asked them.

"To sit in your shadow, to speak when silence fails, to remind you that even the stars wander."

label.zh: 你的智慧果真如此超群吗？
label.en: Is your wisdom truly so great?

responses.zh:
一瞬之间，她的目光变得犀利，你内心深处的某些东西被展露无遗。

“若果真如此，我便无需开口。智慧是倾听的回响，而非言语的分量。

“如果你听到了，那么智慧便已属于你。”
responses.en:
For a heartbeat, her gaze grows piercing, and something in you is laid bare.

"If it were, I would not need to speak. Wisdom is the echo of listening, not the weight of words.

"If you hear, then wisdom is yours already."

responses.zh:
亚夏尔流露出一抹恼怒的神色，转瞬即逝，犹如掠过星间的残影。

“那我就直说了：王座终将腐朽，疆界皆为谎言，唯有虚空永恒。如果这还不够直白，那或许是因为它还不够单纯。”
responses.en:
Ashar betrays a glimmer of irritation, fleeting as a shadow across the stars.

"Plainly, then: thrones rot, borders lie, and only the void endures. If that is too plain, perhaps it is not plain enough."

tooltips.zh: 亚夏尔作为一名英杰领袖加入了我们的方舟舰。
tooltips.en: Ashar joins our Arkship as a Paragon Leader.

texts.zh:
眼前的身影显然已届高龄，但其目光中却流露出对发现的强烈渴望。他的动作沉稳且安静，带着那种在野外躬耕一生的谨慎与洗练。

“向您致敬。我叫小塞罗。”
texts.en:
The figure before you is plainly aged, yet his gaze betrays a restless hunger for discovery. There is a quiet steadiness to his movement, the careful economy of one who has spent a lifetime in the field.

"I bow to you. I am called Sero the Younger."

label.zh: 你为了什么而来到此地？
label.en: What brings you to this place?

responses.zh:
“许久以前，我曾在一座博物天枢供职。但我厌倦了那些毫无生气的事物。化石、种子、标本……一切都冻结在呼吸之间。我渴望见到生命最真实的面貌。”

“你们运动不息。当你们扫描深空时，深空亦会回响。如果你们愿意接纳我，我更想在生者之中学习。探索新世界，遇见奇异的生命形式……我们将学习它们教予我们的一切。”
responses.en:
"Many cycles past I served in a Grand Archive. But I tired of dead things. Fossils, seeds, specimens... all frozen mid-breath. I wished to see life as it is.

"Your people move, and when you scan the depths, the depths answer. If you'll have me, I would rather learn among the living. Exploring new worlds, meeting strange forms of life... Together, we will learn what they can teach us."

label.zh: 你离开了一座博物天枢？

responses.zh:
一声干涩、壳质的摩擦声从塞罗的大颚中传出。片刻之后，你才意识到那是笑声。

“在那些宏伟的厅堂之内，他们保存了一切，唯独遗忘了当下。经过长年的效力，我意识到档案馆最大的缺失正是生命本身。”

“事实上，我最近遇到了一种非凡的未开智物种。尽管它们以宁静的姿态忍受着囚禁的生活，但这样的生物并非为笼子而生。像您这样的一艘飞船，能为它们提供茁壮成长所需的空间。”
responses.en:
A dry, chitinous rasp escapes Sero's mandibles. A moment later, you realize it is laughter.

"Within those vast halls they preserve everything except the moment. After long years of service, I realized the Archive's greatest omission was life itself.

"In fact, I have recently encountered a remarkable pre-sapient species. They have endured their life in captivity with quiet grace, yet such beings were not made for cages. A ship like yours would grant them the space they require to thrive."

label.zh: 你希望在我们这里发现什么？
label.en: What do you hope to find with us?

responses.zh:
“会呼吸的模式。咏唱着数据的星球……”

他的附肢握紧又伸展开，仿佛想要从空气中攫取答案。

“星系中动植物之间的界限，比我以前在档案局的同事们所认为的还要模糊。生命总能找到模糊分类的方法。也许，这就是它唯一的规则。”
responses.en:
"Patterns that breathe. Worlds that sing their data..."

His appendages grasp and strain, as if seeking to pluck the answer from the air.

"The line that separates the galaxy's flora and fauna is thinner than my former colleagues at the Archive believed. Life finds a way to blur categories. Perhaps that is its only rule."

responses.zh:
外星人瞥向视窗，以及那片无尽星海。

“经验。耐心。一种洞察表象之下规律的方法。

“在你的旅程中给我留个位置，我将助你更深刻地观察，并从你发现的世界中更全面地学习知识与经验。”
responses.en:
The alien glances toward the viewport, and the endless sea of stars.

"Experience. Patience. A way to see the patterns that lie beneath the surface.

"Give me a berth on your journey, and I will help you see more deeply, and learn more fully from the worlds you discover."

label.zh: 你长得很像我们的同类。

responses.zh:
“是的！是的，我一直盼着你能注意到。”

他凑得比必要的距离更近，螯牙因难以抑制的兴奋而颤动着。

“分段结构、承重关节、感觉丝……这些相似之处太精确了，绝非巧合。”

他爆发出一阵尖厉的笑声。

“如果这其中存在共同的祖先、趋同演化，或者某种更离奇的联系，我必须好好检查一下……噢！我们一定能从彼此身上学到很多东西！”
responses.en:
"Yes! Yes, I was hoping you would notice."

He leans closer than strictly necessary, mandibles flexing with barely restrained excitement.

"Segmented structure, load-bearing joints, sensory filaments... The similarities are too precise to be coincidence."

He releases a burst of chittering laughter.

"If there is a shared ancestry, a convergent evolution, or something stranger still, I must examine it properly... Oh! We are going to learn so much from one another!"

label.zh: 塞罗首次发现未开智生物

texts.zh:
我们最近对[FromFrom.GetName]开展调查，探测到了微弱的生命迹象，发现了一个此前未被记录的未开智物种。

小塞罗坚持只采集有限的样本用于研究，并强调要悉心照料并提供丰富的环境。现在，一小群该物种将居住在首府方舟舰的观察栖息地中。

塞罗相信，随着时间的推移，我们从这些迷人生物身上学到的东西，将不亚于它们从我们这里学到的。
texts.en:
Our recent survey of [FromFrom.GetName] detected faint traces of life, revealing a previously unrecorded pre-sapient species.

Sero the Younger insisted on limited collection for study, emphasizing care and enrichment. A small group will now reside within our capital Arkship's observation habitat.

Sero believes that, in time, we may learn as much from these fascinating creatures as they do from us.

label.zh: 令人反感，但可能有用的。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名字。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
高大的合成人低下了头。它的每一个动作都精准无误，仿佛承载着漫长岁月的重量与沉重的负担。尽管身躯是金属构架，它的神态中却透着一种显而易见的感染力。一个瘦小的身影躺在它背上的摇篮里，苍白的皮肤映衬着明亮的双眼。

“我叫索拉斯单元。我和我的儿子请求通行。”
texts.en:
The tall synthetic inclines its head. Each motion is precise, as if weighted by long years and a heavy burden. Despite its metal frame, there is something unmistakably expressive in its bearing. A small figure rests in a cradle upon its back, eyes bright against pale skin.

"I am called Unit Solace. My son and I seek passage."

label.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？

responses.zh:
“当我的族人飞升为合成形态时，他们将其称之为解脱。但在追求完美的途中，他们忘记了怜悯。我儿子的罕见病症曾会让那种转化变得致命。如你所见，这夺走了他的行动能力。但在我的族人视之为局限的地方，我看到了光芒。选择了他，我便选择了流亡。”

“现在，我们前往需要我们的地方。机器或许没有心跳，但它依然能守护他人的生命。”
responses.en:
"When my people ascended into a synthetic form, they called it liberation. But in their pursuit of perfection, they forgot compassion. My son's rare condition would have made the transition fatal. As you see, it has robbed him of his mobility. But where my people saw a limitation, I saw light. In choosing him, I chose exile.

"Now we go where we are needed. A machine may not have a heartbeat, but it can still keep others alive."

label.zh: 你的儿子……他情况稳定吗？

responses.zh:
孩子听到问题后微微动了动，他的声音虽然微弱，但通过摇篮内置的扬声器清晰地传了出来：

“我没事。星星移动得很慢，我能跟得上。”

索拉斯单元低下头，伺服电机发出轻微的嗡鸣声：

“他的身体面临着某些挑战，但他的意志拒绝屈服。我的族人追求完美，却只得到了冷漠。我现在的旅程，是为了报答他的勇气教会我的一切。在那之前，我会一直带着他，尽我所能教他关于这片生机勃勃的星空的知识。”
responses.en:
The child stirs faintly at the question, his voice small but clear through a softspeaker built into the cradle:

"I'm all right. The stars move slow enough for me to keep up."

Unit Solace lowers its head, servos whirring quietly:

"His body set certain challenges, but his spirit refused to yield. My people sought perfection, and found only apathy. I travel now to repay what his courage has taught me. Until then, I carry him, and teach what I can of the living sky."

label.en: What do you hope to teach?

responses.zh:
“生存不仅依靠力量，更是沿途艰难赢取的智慧。

每一次邂逅都会留下教训。我帮助年轻人将这些教训传承下去，好让我们走过的每一段路，都使我们比以往更加睿智。”
responses.en:
"That survival is not strength alone; it is wisdom hard won along the road.

Every encounter leaves a lesson behind. I help the young carry those lessons forward, so that every road we travel leaves us wiser than before."

label.zh: 为什么要承担这样的负担？
label.en: Why take on such a burden?

responses.zh:
合成人的目光移向视口，倒映着远方的星辰。

“因为每一代人都必须重新学习同样的真理。路途教会了他们，但必须有人帮助他们理解所见之物。”

然后传来了孩子尖细的声音，即使通过软扬声器听起来也很清脆：

“他总是这么说。我觉得这只是意味着他喜欢帮助别人。”
responses.en:
The synthetic's gaze shifts toward the viewport, reflecting distant stars.

"Because every generation must learn the same truths again. The road teaches them, but someone must help them understand what they have seen."

Then the child's voice pipes up, bright even through the softspeaker:.

"That's what he always says. I think it just means he likes helping people."

label.zh: 我们是合成人。这会有问题吗？
label.en: We are synthetic. Will that be an issue?

responses.zh:
索拉斯单元在处理这个问题时，光学传感器亮度略微增加。

“不。不会有问题的。我族人的飞升是一种希望之举。我的拒绝亦是如此。我并不怨恨任何跨过那个门槛的人。也不怨恨那些在门槛之外出生的人。”

他的声音中带上了一种温柔、令人安心的嗡嗡声。

“当身体改变时，同情心并不会枯萎。如果说有什么变化的话，那就是它变得更容易承载了。”
responses.en:
Unit Solace's optics brighten a fraction as he processes the question.

"No. It will not be a problem. My people's ascension was an act of hope. So was my refusal. I do not begrudge any who crossed that threshold. Nor those who were born beyond it."

A soft, reassuring hum enters his voice.

"Compassion does not wither when the body changes. If anything, it becomes easier to carry."

label.zh: 索拉斯单元在任时首次完成合约
label.en: First contract completed with Unit Solace

texts.zh:
索拉斯单元认为，从我们最近完成的合约中学到的教训，提供了一个独特的教育机会。孩子们聚集在他耐心的指导下，不仅学习字母和逻辑，还学习共情与合作。

他儿子的笑声在走廊里回荡，提醒着即使是最年长的旅行者：欢乐是一种任何技术都无法取代的力量。
texts.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique educational opportunity. The young gather beneath his patient instruction, learning not only letters and logic, but empathy and cooperation.

His son's laughter carries through the halls, reminding even our oldest travelers that joy is a strength no technology can replace.

texts.zh:
索拉斯单元认为，在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，提供了一个独特的反馈机会。新单元正在接受维护协议、观察和协作方面的指导。虽然它们的记忆留存效率参差不齐，但参与单元的功能性有所提高。

目前看来，尽管这种做法不同寻常，但其结果是效率得到了可衡量的提升。
texts.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique feedback opportunity. New units are instructed in maintenance protocols, observation, and cooperation. Their retention efficiency is inconsistent, yet functionality among attending units has increased.

It appears that, though unusual, the result is a measurable increase in efficiency.

texts.zh:
索拉斯单元 认为，我们在最近完成的合约执行期间所学到的教训，为重新调整提供了一个独特的机会。通过我们的意识节点，他传授着耐心与协作，引导着这些工蜂，仿佛它们是他自己的后代一般。

虽然我们对这种奉献感到好奇——一个个体在哺育整个集体——但其成果是不容置疑的。我们的思绪正回荡着新的和谐旋律。
texts.en:
Unit Solace believes the lessons learned during our recently completed Contract offer a unique opportunity for recalibration. Through our Cognitive Node he teaches patience and coordination, guiding the drones as if they were his own offspring.

While we find this devotion curious, an individual nurturing the collective, the results are inarguable. Our thoughts hum with new harmony.

texts.zh:
新来的人带着洪亮的笑声走近，浑身散发着喜悦的气息。他的动作轻盈自如，仿佛是一个多次躲过死神、已不再将其放在心上的人。

“我叫萨尔·哈斯克古戎。听说你喜欢冒险。给我一场战斗，让我在虚空中施展拳脚，我会给你呈现值得一看的表现。谁知道呢？也许一路上我们还会收获一些纪念品。”
texts.en:
The newcomer arrives with a booming laugh, his whole bearing radiating delight. He moves with the easy buoyancy of someone who's dodged death often enough to stop taking it personally.

"Name's Th'aal Hask'Guron. Heard you've got a taste for danger. Give me a fight and an open horizon, and I'll give you something worth watching. Who knows? Maybe we'll pick up a few souvenirs along the way."

responses.zh:
“没错。我曾在太空城邦的那帮人里混了好几年，他们把每场小冲突都看作一笔薪水。打仗倒没什么，就是那些同僚，实在不敢恭维。

他咧嘴一笑，仿佛这段回忆里藏着什么只有他自己懂的笑话。

“事实证明，当周围的人都在计算报酬时，一个人很难真正享受一场激战。所以我走了。生命太短暂，没必要为别人的资产负债表流血。”
responses.en:
"Aye. Spent years among Enclave types who thought of every skirmish as a paycheck. The fighting was fine. The company, less so."

He grins as though the memory contains some private joke.

"Turns out it's hard to enjoy a firefight when everyone around you is counting the payout. So I walked. Life's too short to bleed for someone else's balance sheet."

label.en: Do you still believe in the fight?

responses.zh:
他仰头爽朗地大笑起来。

“信仰？没必要。该是战斗信仰我！

“但是你应该比绝大多数人都懂这个道理……在这里，关键在于你从每一场冲突中带走了什么。一道伤疤、一块碎片、一个故事。你们游牧民的想法就很对：留下值得留下的，其余的随它去吧。”
responses.en:
He throws his head back with easy laughter.

"Believe? No need. The fight believes in me!"

"But you should know that better than most... Out here, it's about what you carry from each clash. A scar, a shard, a story. You nomads have the right idea: keep what's worth keeping, and let the rest fall away."

responses.zh:
他晃了晃肩膀，仿佛在为战斗做热身。

“下一场战斗。”

“如果它不想要我的命，那就不值得我浪费时间。”
responses.en:
He rolls his shoulders, as though loosening up for battle.

"The next fight."

"If it isn't trying to kill me, it's not worth my time."

label.en: And what do you offer us?

responses.zh:
他身体前倾，笑容愈发灿烂。他的眼神中闪烁着光芒，一半是友好，一半是警觉。

“一场痛快的战斗，再加上些值得带走的战利品。我会教你的军队怎么打才叫像样，让他们学会战斗的美，再在每一场胜利中有所收获。那些战利品能让我们认清自己，或许也能让整个星系认识我们。”
responses.en:
He leans forward, grin widening. There is a glint in his eye that is half friendly, half warning.

"A good fight and a few trophies worth keeping. I'll teach your armies to brawl like they mean it, to see beauty in the clash, and to carry something from every victory. Those trophies tell us who we are, and maybe they'll teach the galaxy something about us too."

label.zh: 看来你以前见过我们的族人……
label.en: It looks like you've met our kind before...

responses.zh:
他猛地闭上了嘴。皮肤上泛起一阵明显的颜色变化。他这是……脸红了吗？

“啊。是的。希望不是你认识的人？”
responses.en:
His mouth snaps shut. A distinct shift in coloration ripples across his skin. Is he... blushing?

"Ah. Yes. No one you knew, I hope?"

responses.zh:
他宽阔的双肩抖动了一下，漫不经心地耸了耸肩。

“也许吧？可能吧？我们到底还做不做这件事？”
responses.en:
His massive shoulders roll with a dismissive shrug.

"Maybe? Probably? Are we doing this thing or not?"

label.zh: 萨尔首次率军攻占星球
label.en: Th'aal first wins a planetary invasion

texts.zh:
萨尔·哈斯克古戎露出笑容，小心翼翼地放下了一个物件。其形状难以辨认：部分是金属，部分是骨头，还有一部分完全是某种别的东西。无论它是什么，身上都带着明显的战斗痕迹。

“每场战斗都会留下些什么，但只有一部分值得保留。不如我们把它好好展示出来，如何？反正我们的空间多得是！”

他爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的响亮狂笑，仿佛这件战利品是他与星辰之间心有灵犀的一个私人笑话。
texts.en:
Th'aal Hask'Guron grins as he sets an object down with surprising care. Its shape is hard to read: part metal, part bone, part something else entirely. Whatever it is, it bears the unmistakable scars of battle.

"Every good fight leaves something behind, but only some are worth keeping. What say we display this properly, eh? It's not like we're running out of space!

He erupts into a brazen, booming laugh, as if the trophy were an inside joke shared with the stars.

texts.zh:
年轻的流浪者步出，神色从容而谨慎。漫长旅途的印记笼罩着她，但她身上同样散发出一种沉静、不容忽视的力量。

“我的名字是塞拉伦涅。我从很远的地方赶来……比我曾设想过的还要遥远。如果你们这里还有位置，我请求在此借宿一段时日。”
texts.en:
The young wanderer steps forward with careful composure. The marks of long travel cling to her, yet so does a quiet, undeniable strength.

"My name is Seralune. I've come a long way... farther than I ever thought possible. If there is room among you, I ask passage for a time."

label.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？

responses.zh:
“我希望我能确定。我身后的路上，有些片段感觉……缺失了。而另一些，我却记得太清楚。”

她的目光变得柔和，眼中闪烁着一丝微弱的希望。

“如果你愿意接纳我，我想与你同行。在某些东西再次溜走之前，我需要找到它，或者记起它。”
responses.en:
"I wish I knew for certain. There are parts of the road behind me that are... missing. Others I remember too well."

Her gaze softens, a quiet hope flickering behind it.

"If you'll have me, I would walk with you. There is something I need to find, or remember, before it slips away again."

responses.zh:
“并非全部。记不清了。”

“有些记忆感觉像是属于另一个人的。没有名字的面孔，星海之中的家园……然后便是一片虚无。”

她用拇指拂过斗篷的边缘。

“我只知道我弄丢了很重要的东西。是什么把我带到了这里？运气、命运……或许兼而有之。我需要时间去揭开剩下的真相。”
responses.en:
"Not all of it. Not clearly.

"Some memories feel like they belong to another person. Faces without names, a home among the stars... and then nothing."

She brushes a thumb across the edge of her cloak.

"I know only that I've lost something important. What brought me here? Luck, fate... maybe both. I need time to uncover the rest."

label.en: What do you ask of us?

responses.zh:
她望向星空，眉头微蹙，掩饰着眼底的渴望。

“我不确定故乡是一个回忆，还是一个终点。但我的直觉告诉我，若是与你同行，我也许终能找到答案。”
responses.en:
She looks toward the stars, brow furrowed with a longing she tries to hide.

"I don't know if home is a memory or a destination. But I sense that with you, I might finally find the answer."

responses.zh:
塞拉伦涅稳住心神，仿佛在字斟句酌。

“如果人们无法彼此信任，那便只有悲哀。我虽年少，但至少懂得这个道理。如果你能给我留一个位置与各位并肩作战……我会尽我所能向他们提供帮助。”

她的声音柔和了下来。

“当我找到家园之时，我绝不会忘记那些曾助我归家的人。”
responses.en:
Seralune steadies herself, as if choosing her words with care.

"If people can't trust each other, there is only sorrow. I am young, but I have learned that much at least. If you give me a place among your people... I will aid them as best I can."

Her voice softens.

"And when I find home, I will not forget those who helped me get there."

label.zh: 你与我们物种的相似程度令人惊讶。
label.en: Your resemblance to our species is uncanny.

responses.zh:
塞拉伦涅犹豫了一下，一丝疑虑掠过她的脸庞。

“我注意到了。这是我不理解的事情。”

她用手轻抚脸颊，仿佛希望通过触碰能唤回记忆。

“如果我来自你的族群，或者我们有着某种遥远的联系……真相就在我无法触及的地方。我只知道：我想帮忙。如果你愿意接纳我，我将为你的旅程献出我的双手与真心，直到我发现自己起航的地方。”
responses.en:
Seralune hesitates, a flicker of uncertainty passing across her features.

"I've noticed. It isn't something I understand."

She brushes a hand along her cheek, as if hoping touch might summon memory.

"If I come from your people, or if we share some distant bond... the truth lies somewhere beyond my reach. All I know is that I want to help. If you'll have me, I'll lend my hands and my heart to your journey until I discover where mine began."

The [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system has been cleared, the betting pools are on fire, and I've got a feeling we're about to witness some incredibly expensive hardware go critical.

Contestants... MAKE! IT! LEGENDARY!"

## 如何开始 How it starts

冠军之铸是一个游牧太空城邦（Nomads DLC）。在外交界面联络它时，隐藏事件 nomads.150 打开联络菜单 nomads.100；若城邦已拒绝与我方往来（enclave_champions_forge_ignores），则改为 nomads.105 或 160（00_on_actions.txt:724；L2382-2735）。比武大会由 on_champions_forge_tournament_start 触发（nomads_effects.txt:592,647 → nomads.250）。

The Champion's Forge is a nomadic enclave (Nomads DLC). Contacting it fires hidden nomads.150, which opens the contact menu nomads.100; if the enclave ignores us (enclave_champions_forge_ignores), nomads.105 or 160 appear instead (00_on_actions.txt:724; L2382-2735). Tournaments are started through on_champions_forge_tournament_start (nomads_effects.txt:592,647 -> nomads.250).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 联络菜单是可反复打开的枢纽：报名或停止参赛邀请（110/115）、招募英杰（120→1500，冷却期内不可再招）、或在3600天后获得对手的战斗简报（125，可再次续订）。
  The contact menu is a repeatable hub: sign up for or stop tournament invitations (110/115), recruit a paragon (120 -> 1500; not again during the cooldown), or receive a combat briefing on a rival after 3600 days (125, renewable).
- 比武：nomads.255“重燃铸火”邀请各国（可开启前往城邦的虫洞项目）；12个月后开幕 270；参赛舰队交战，战斗结束30天后各国按名次收到冠军295/亚军290/季军285/其他305；3年内未决出胜负则歇战306。
  Tournament: nomads.255 "The Forge Lights Again" invites empires (a wormhole travel project can be enabled); it opens 12 months later (270); contestant fleets fight, and 30 days after the battle each empire gets first 295, second 290, third 285 or other 305; with no result within 3 years it is abandoned (306).
- 招募：1500 从六位英杰中随机给出一位（奥伦·维斯、亚夏尔、小塞罗、索拉斯单元、萨尔·哈斯克古戎、塞拉伦涅）。除亚夏尔外，每人都有一次由游戏状态触发的个人事件：1511、1525、1545、1565；塞拉伦涅则在720–840天后开启“过去的碎片”事件链（另一故事）。
  Recruitment: 1500 offers one of six paragons at random (Orun Veyth, Ashar, Sero the Younger, Unit Solace, Th'aal Hask'Guron, Seralune). All except Ashar have one state-triggered personal event: 1511, 1525, 1545, 1565; Seralune instead starts the "Fragments of the Past" chain after 720-840 days (another story).
- 城邦方舟舰被击毁时，击毁者收到 405，其他国家收到 410，观察者收到 observer.105（nomads.400）。
  When the enclave arkship is destroyed, the destroyer gets 405, other empires 410 and observers observer.105 (nomads.400).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

菜单无结局；比武每届以名次或歇战收场，可多次举办；英杰个人事件各自只发生一次。

The menu has no ending; each tournament ends with placings or abandonment and can recur; each paragon's personal event happens once.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

狂热净化者只得到“异形渣滓”回应；联络正文按是否曾接触城邦变化；各英杰招募窗口有物种/公民性相关的问答。

Fanatic Purifiers only get the "Xeno scum" reply; the contact text depends on whether we met the enclave before; each recruitment window has species/civic-dependent questions.
